summary.en: The National Forestry and Grassland Administration released a five-year report card for China's first batch of national parks, saying ecosystems keep improving and flagship species such as Siberian tigers and Hainan gibbons have seen significant population growth.
summary.zh_hans: 国家林草局公布首批国家公园设立五年成果，生态环境持续改善，东北虎、海南长臂猿等标志性物种种群显著增长。
summary.zh_hant: 國家林草局公布首批國家公園設立五年成果，生態環境持續改善，東北虎、海南長臂猿等標誌性物種種群顯著增長。

title.en: China's first batch of national parks delivers five-year ecological report card

summary.en: The rebuilt Huanggang Port opened at 6:30am, implementing the new "joint inspection, one release" clearance model. Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki and security chief Tang Ping-keung inspected the operation and said it ran smoothly, with all immigration counters opened to let officers get familiar with the new flow.

summary.en: A Sudanese civil society group said a gold mine in the North Wadi area near the Egyptian border was hit by a large-scale airstrike on 10 October, killing 72 miners. The statement accused the Egyptian air force; Egypt and Sudan have not responded. Sudan's civil war, now in its fourth year, has killed at least 59,000 people.
summary.zh_hans: 苏丹一个民间组织发表声明称，北部靠近埃及边境北瓦迪地区一处金矿10日遭遇大规模空袭，造成72名矿工死亡。声明指责埃及空军，埃及与苏丹官方均未回应。苏丹内战已持续三年多，造成至少5.9万人死亡。
summary.zh_hant: 蘇丹一個民間組織發表聲明稱，北部靠近埃及邊境北瓦迪地區一處金礦10日遭遇大規模空襲，造成72名礦工死亡。聲明指責埃及空軍，埃及與蘇丹官方均未回應。蘇丹內戰已持續三年多，造成至少5.9萬人死亡。

title.en: Airstrike hits Sudan gold mine near Egyptian border, killing 72 miners
title.zh_hans: 苏丹北部金矿遇袭　已致72名矿工死亡
title.zh_hant: 蘇丹北部金礦遇襲　已致72名礦工死亡

summary.en: The cross-boundary "Huanggang shuttle bus" (皇巴士) ran its final service this morning after nearly 30 years, bowing out as the new Huanggang Port opens. Security chief Tang Ping-keung and bus fans gathered to bid it farewell.

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan wrote in his blog that hardware improvements such as the new Huanggang Port clearance, together with mega events including Hong Kong hosting its first APEC finance ministers' meeting, will further cement Hong Kong's status as an international finance and trade hub — hardware to strengthen "internal connectivity", events to promote "external outreach".
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波发表网志，指新皇岗口岸通关等硬件完善，加上香港首办APEC财长会议等盛事，将进一步彰显香港国际金融与商贸枢纽地位——硬件加强“内联”、盛事促进“外通”。

summary.en: The US Department of Defense updated its casualty database to show 21 US military personnel killed and 865 wounded in the US-Iran conflict. The revision, following earlier accusations that figures were underreported, has renewed controversy over the Pentagon's casualty accounting.
summary.zh_hans: 美国国防部更新伤亡数据库，显示美伊战事中美军已有21人死亡、865人受伤。此前官方数据被指低报，今次修订再引外界质疑五角大楼伤亡统计的透明度。
summary.zh_hant: 美國國防部更新傷亡數據庫，顯示美伊戰事中美軍已有21人死亡、865人受傷。此前官方數據被指低報，今次修訂再引外界質疑五角大樓傷亡統計的透明度。

title.en: Pentagon revises US casualty figures in US-Iran conflict upward, reigniting controversy

summary.en: Tim Cook made his first visit to China since stepping down as Apple CEO, saying Apple will step up its business in Guangdong. During the trip he visited Guangzhou, including the set of a Wing Chun-themed short film shot on the iPhone 18 Pro.
summary.zh_hans: 卸任苹果CEO后的库克首次访华，表示苹果将加码广东业务。期间他到访广州，包括探班一部以iPhone 18 Pro拍摄的咏春题材短片。
summary.zh_hant: 卸任蘋果CEO後的庫克首次訪華，表示蘋果將加碼廣東業務。期間他到訪廣州，包括探班一部以iPhone 18 Pro拍攝的詠春題材短片。

title.en: Tim Cook visits China for first time since stepping down as Apple CEO, pledges bigger Guangdong push

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded to US President Donald Trump's suggestion that Ukraine should change its leader, saying the country's leader should be decided by the Ukrainian people. He said holding elections under wartime conditions would be extremely difficult, but one could be considered if Russia agreed to a 60-day ceasefire.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基回应美国总统特朗普有关乌克兰应更换领导人的言论，表示乌领导人应由乌克兰人民决定。他指在战争状态下举行选举极具困难，但若俄方同意停火60天，可考虑举办选举。
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基回應美國總統特朗普有關烏克蘭應更換領導人的言論，表示烏領導人應由烏克蘭人民決定。他指在戰爭狀態下舉行選舉極具困難，但若俄方同意停火60天，可考慮舉辦選舉。

title.en: Zelensky: Ukraine's leader should be chosen by Ukrainians; holding elections now is very difficult
title.zh_hans: 泽连斯基：乌克兰领导人应由乌国人民决定　现时举行选举很难
title.zh_hant: 澤連斯基：烏克蘭領導人應由烏國人民決定　現時舉行選舉很難

summary.en: US President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy ceasefire. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded that Ukraine would agree if Russia does. The exchange comes as US-Ukraine ties strain over Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and Trump's remarks about a leadership change in Kyiv.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意实施能源停火。乌克兰总统泽连斯基回应指，若俄方同意，乌方亦会同意。双方表态之际，美乌关系因乌军袭击俄炼油厂及特朗普有关更换乌领导人的言论而趋紧张。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普表示，俄羅斯和烏克蘭已同意實施能源停火。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基回應指，若俄方同意，烏方亦會同意。雙方表態之際，美烏關係因烏軍襲擊俄煉油廠及特朗普有關更換烏領導人的言論而趨緊張。

title.en: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire; Zelensky says Ukraine will agree if Russia does

summary.en: A boat carrying 305 people capsized off the coast of Djibouti, killing at least 139 people including children, with 84 others still missing. Search and rescue operations are ongoing; the cause of the accident is under investigation.

summary.zh_hant: 一艘載有305人的船隻在非洲吉布提沿海翻沉，至少139人死亡，包括兒童，另有84人仍然失蹤。搜救工作仍在進行，事故原因有待調查。

title.en: Boat capsizes off Djibouti killing at least 139, dozens missing
